modules.name: POSS

Instant multi-branch stock transfers and reconciliation
Automated GST, HSN, and landed-cost calculation

modules.name: CRM
modules.description: Turn everyday chats into follow-ups, orders, and retained customers.
modules.context: B2B sales in India happen on WhatsApp. Svantham turns conversations into tracked pipelines, quotations, and closed deals.
features: Shared team WhatsApp inbox with unlimited telecaller seats
Automated quotation dispatch and order status pings
Call dispositions and customer transaction history

modules.name: HRMS
modules.description: Attendance, payroll, and people ops built for the real workforce.
modules.context: Built for factory floors, retail chains, and field crews. No per-employee pricing tiers that punish hiring.
features: Biometric & selfie punch-in ready with geo-tagging
Daily wage, overtime, and kharcha cash advance ledger
One-click compliant payroll run via standard bank formats

features: Delivery challans with scrap & wastage tracking
Multi-stage vendor job work tracking and reconciliations
Bill of Materials (BOM) costing and yield variance analysis

modules.name: FSM
modules.description: Send the right person to the right job with less phone-tag.
modules.context: Dispatch industrial technicians, maintenance teams, and installers with offline mobile job cards and signatures.
features: Offline Android job cards with customer e-signature
Service ticket lifecycle and technician location dispatch
Spares consumption tracking with warranty expiry alerts

modules.name: OMS
modules.description: Give your B2B network a faster way to order and grow.
modules.context: A dedicated B2B portal for your distributor and retailer network with tiered trade credit and live warehouse availability.
features: Tiered wholesale pricing and dealer credit limit control
Real-time warehouse stock visibility for verified dealers
Zero transaction fee ordering with direct dispatch queuing

description.challenge: Needed to digitize civil and mechanical workflows (ISO drawings, spools, welding joints, material listings, and QA/QC image inspections) for 500+ employees.
description.solution: Engineered automated Excel report generation and maintained a robust Django backend deployed via Apache WSGI. Administered the Ubuntu host server and minimized page load latency through comprehensive database indexing.
description.impact: Successfully supported 1000s of records updated in real-time by many employees concurrently across the proprietary UWIS platform.

description.challenge: Founder Vijay needed to automate lead tracking and course management, along with Google Meet scheduling to save time.
description.solution: Built a custom CRM with automated class scheduling via a Google service account. Used Upstash Redis, Resend API, and a Go Fiber server to handle heavy request threading and automated emails.
description.impact: Helped the founder save 10x of his time, allowing him to focus entirely on his true passion: teaching music.

description.challenge: Needed a billing/sales POS product to help companies simplify billing, manage cash flow, and track payments natively.
description.solution: Developed a Flutter application with Firebase integrations for native notifications and Google sign-in support. Handled Play Store publishing and bundle compatibility.
description.impact: Significantly reduced development time, enabled future App Store expansion, and delivered a scalable multi-platform application.

description.challenge: As a leading industrial valve supplier, Seyonflo historically relied on static PowerPoint presentations to showcase their complex product lines to clients. This manual approach severely limited their reach, made product updates cumbersome, and lacked the professional digital presence required to compete in the modern B2B manufacturing sector.
description.solution: We designed and developed a modern, high-performance portfolio website tailored specifically for the industrial space. By migrating their catalog from offline slides to a dynamic web platform, we built a responsive, easily navigable site with a heavy emphasis on technical SEO optimization and clean architecture.
description.impact: The transition instantly elevated Seyonflo's professional credibility. The new SEO-optimized platform is now actively driving organic website traffic, generating inbound leads, and providing their sales team with a powerful, always-up-to-date digital catalog to share with global buyers.

description.challenge: SGS Technologie needed to attract the right B2B audience in Florida.
description.solution: Engineered targeted, high-quality website content tailored for B2B engagement.
description.impact: Successfully converted web traffic into measurable business leads.

description.challenge: Srinsoft Technologies needed to rank higher in modern search engines, including AI Overviews.
description.solution: Wrote a highly optimized technical blog targeting specific engineering keywords and AEO strategies.
description.impact: Blog successfully ranks in Google SERPs and frequently appears in AI Overviews.

tailoredPortfolio.name: SEO and AI Optimized Technical Blog

description.challenge: Satori Creatives needed to engage B2C customers and build brand trust.
description.solution: Developed compelling B2C website content focused on customer engagement and trust-building.
description.impact: Drove higher conversions and significantly improved customer trust metrics.

description.challenge: ForeFind needed a comprehensive buyer's guide to explain franchise investments.
description.solution: Created an SEO/GEO optimized landing page explaining investment ranges, ROI, legal considerations, and decision-making steps.
description.impact: Provided clear, actionable guidance for potential franchise buyers, increasing lead quality.

description.challenge: Identify and resolve critical business bottlenecks.
description.solution: A thought leadership article about interoperability problems through storytelling, real-world examples, and business impact.
description.impact: Delivered measurable improvements in operational efficiency and market reach.

tailoredPortfolio.name: Executive-friendly Technical Article for Engineering Services
